messages.subject: annotation with known enhancers
parts:
Hi, 
Can I annotate differentially methylated regions with known enhancer sets. I am looking for a function  like annotate.WithGenicParts which uses gene.obj but which gives me enhancer annotations also.
Thanks--Sumithra

You can use annotate.WithFeature() function for that.

Best,

parts:
Hi Altuna, 
Thanks, your reply was helpful.  I have been trying to get a list of all known enhancers in the mm9 assembly similar to the one you have uploaded as 
http://methylkit.googlecode.com/files/all.enhancers.hg18.hmm.bed
in methylkit. Can you tell mw how to download the annotation file for enhancers  in mm9 in the same format. All my tries have been unsuccessful so far.
Thanks for your help,
Sumithra

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] annotation with known enhancers
parts: you can try to download p300 Chip-seq peaks for mm9. I derived those enhancers from chromHMM software results which were available for ENCODE project. I don't know those are available for mm9, unless you run the software yourself.
